The '''''Valor''''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that served as the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. It was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jard]] and saw action in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and after.
